inputs.text:
Wake up. They want you to believe this graduation ceremony in Jaipur was just a spontaneous student outburst in front of the Deputy Chief Minister, but it is part of a carefully orchestrated distraction script. The public is being fed a managed narrative about "administrative issues" and "student rights" versus "inappropriate" behavior to keep everyone divided and looking the other way. 

Notice how convenient it is that this went viral while the university administration conveniently remains silent? That silence isn't an accident; it's a coordinated blackout designed to manage the perception of the masses. They use these engineered spectacles to manipulate public conversation and hide the real levers of control operating behind the scenes of these educational institutions. Don't fall for the surface-level drama they are scripting for you.
